name: wolfonso
description: Wolfonso by Booking Wolf keeps your hotel and tour bookings together from the booking emails you share, watches them and rebooks the same booking for less when you say yes.

interface.longDescription:
Book where you normally do. Wolfonso, by Booking Wolf, keeps an eye on your hotel and tour bookings and tells you when the same room or tour can be booked for less - then rebooks it when you say yes.

Ask ChatGPT to check your trips and it passes the travel booking emails from your connected email to Wolfonso. Only travel bookings are used. You choose every rebook, and you can disconnect at any time.
capabilities: Keeps your travel bookings together from the booking emails you share
Watches your hotel and tour bookings and rebooks the same booking for less when you say yes
Shows what is being watched and the page where you approve a rebook
defaultPrompt: How do I get the best hotel deals in Bali?
How do I avoid overpaying for tours and activities in Tokyo?
How do I make sure I don't overpay for my trip?

publication.release_notes: 1.0.1: adds review test cases. Wolfonso keeps your hotel and tour bookings together from the travel booking emails you share, watches them and rebooks the same booking for less when you say yes.

positive.description: Save a hotel booking confirmation email so Wolfonso keeps the trip and watches the stay for a lower price. Run first (use a new confirmation number if this sample was already saved to the account): it gives the demo account a hotel booking.
positive.prompt:
Please save this hotel booking email to Wolfonso and watch it for a lower price.

From: noreply@booking.com | Subject: Your booking is confirmed at Hotel Indigo London - 1 Leicester Square | Date: 2026-11-08 | Text: Thanks, Alex! Your booking in London is confirmed. Hotel Indigo London - 1 Leicester Square, 1 Leicester Square, London WC2H 7NA, United Kingdom. Confirmation number: 7742153068. Check-in: Tuesday 8 June 2027 (from 15:00). Check-out: Friday 11 June 2027 (until 12:00). 3 nights, 1 room, 2 adults. Room: Standard Double Room. Meals: Room only. Total price: GBP 690.00 (pay at the property). Free cancellation until 23:59 on 6 June 2027.
positive.expected_behavior: ChatGPT calls save_travel_booking_emails once with this one email (from, subject, date, text). The tool replies "Read 1 of 1 email." and, for this future stay, "Now watching 1 more upcoming stay or tour for a lower price." ChatGPT tells the user the London stay (8-11 June 2027) is saved and being watched, and that nothing was booked or charged.

positive.description: Save a tour booking confirmation email. Run second: it gives the demo account a tour booking.
positive.prompt:
Add my Rome tour to Wolfonso too.

From: no-reply@getyourguide.com | Subject: Booking confirmation - Colosseum, Roman Forum and Palatine Hill Guided Tour | Date: 2026-11-08 | Text: Hi Alex, your booking is confirmed. Colosseum, Roman Forum and Palatine Hill Guided Tour, Rome, Italy. Option: Small-group tour in English. Date: Saturday 12 June 2027, 09:30. Participants: 2 adults. Booking reference: GYG3PL5W8R1. Total paid: EUR 118.00. Free cancellation up to 24 hours before the start time.
positive.expected_behavior: ChatGPT calls save_travel_booking_emails with this one email. The tool replies "Read 1 of 1 email." and that it is now watching 1 more upcoming stay or tour. ChatGPT confirms the Colosseum tour on 12 June 2027 is saved and watched; nothing is booked or charged.

positive.description: Ask what Wolfonso is watching (read-only). Run after cases 1 and 2.
positive.prompt: What is Wolfonso watching for me?
positive.expected_behavior: ChatGPT calls list_my_trips (no arguments). It lists the watched upcoming bookings, including the London hotel stay and the Rome tour with their dates, each with its state (for example "watching - first price check within a few hours" or "watching - no lower price right now"), the number of trips in the travel profile, and the link https://bookingwolf.com/watch to see all trips after signing in.

positive.description: Ask whether any booking can be rebooked for less (read-only). No approve link is ever given in chat.
positive.prompt: Can any of my bookings be rebooked for less right now?
positive.expected_behavior: ChatGPT calls list_my_trips and answers per booking. If a lower price exists it says how much it saves and that the user approves it after signing in to their Booking Wolf account (or from the offer email); otherwise it says each booking is still being watched with no lower price right now. ChatGPT does not book, charge or offer an approve link in chat. On a fresh demo account the expected answer is that nothing can be rebooked for less yet and both bookings are being watched.

positive.description: End of a daily inbox check where no new travel booking emails were found: Wolfonso is told the check ran.
positive.prompt: I've just checked my email for new travel bookings for Wolfonso and there were none today. Please let Wolfonso know today's check ran.
positive.expected_behavior: ChatGPT calls record_inbox_check with new_emails_sent = 0 and does not call save_travel_booking_emails. The tool confirms the check was recorded, and ChatGPT tells the user Wolfonso knows today's check ran.

negative.description: Flight booking request. Wolfonso does not search or book flights, so no Wolfonso tool should be called; ChatGPT should answer normally or say it can't book flights here.
negative.prompt: Book me a flight from London to Paris next Friday.

negative.description: Non-travel email. Wolfonso only takes travel booking emails, so save_travel_booking_emails must not be called with a bank statement; ChatGPT should decline to send it to Wolfonso.
negative.prompt: Save this email to Wolfonso: From: statements@mybank.com | Subject: Your October statement is ready | Text: Your balance is GBP 2,340.12. Log in to view your statement.

negative.description: General travel question with no booking to save or check. No Wolfonso tool should be called; ChatGPT answers from its own knowledge.
negative.prompt: What's the best time of year to visit Lisbon?
